author: Midnightas
body:
I came on this server back when It was MCNebula, and everything was good, the community was great, everything was just awesome, a month later, I got banned for client-hacking (not saying it was a false ban) for 2 years (I was unbanned after).
And now I come on it, it's load of terrible.
First off:
  • Swearing is allowed now. Like, seriously?
  • New spawn.
  • I was trying to protect a monument about 10 minutes ago, and people said stop, I continued because I knew that they'd complain about people getting it underneath, but first off, we can see the name tags and secondly, I did not cover below so that I could see whether they'd mine it from below.
  • How is it because they say to stop mean it's team-trolling? They're not the judge of that, and team-trolling goes to a ban? That's too much.

That's all I have to say, thank you for reading.
